test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 14 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The line chart given below shows the income and expenditure of a company in five years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87619e9aa4c1f8d97fbac1585f24a7d303b450697f86b276f46548031457890a.png] 

Saving = Income - Expenditure

What is the difference between the average income and average saving in year C and D together?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Average income of C and D together = (600 + 400)/2 = 500

Saving of C = 600 - 200 = 400

Saving of D = 400 - 100 = 300

Average saving of C and D together = (400 + 300)/2 = 350

The difference between the average income and average savings in year C and D together is = 500
